_comment: Reference-only upstream skills. Nothing here is vendored into this repo.
scripts/fetch_upstream.py resolves each entry at install time, caches it under
'ref' is a full commit SHA, never a branch. A pinned SHA cannot be moved by an
upstream force-push. Run `fetch_upstream.py --upgrade` to re-resolve against HEAD
and review the diff before bumping.
'interactive' true means the skill needs a live human and is excluded from

grill.why: Works the ask as a design tree in rounds, and dispatches sub-agents for facts rather than asking you what it could look up.

echo.why: Turns a rambling or dictated brief into an echo brief, with the model's own guesses quarantined from your words.

done.why: Writes observable AC-NNN acceptance criteria with a verification method each, so done is a fact rather than an opinion.

brainstorm.why: The hard gate. Three paths (spike, bounded, architectural) with staged approval; approval of an idea does not approve artefacts that do not exist yet.
brainstorm.interactive_note: Its interview needs a human, but it installs everywhere on purpose. An autonomous run that hits the design gate with no brainstorm skill present gets blocked without being told why.

research.why: Background agent that reads primary sources only and cites every claim, so expert knowledge enters the work as evidence rather than recall.

doubt.why: Materialises a fresh-context reviewer biased to disprove, while course-correction is still cheap.

prove.why: No completion claim without fresh verification output. Carries a table of claim to what actually proves it.

bar.why: Writes the quality bar down with numbers, then watches the diff for it being quietly lowered.

scope.why: Compares the diff against the stated intent and turns drift into keep, split, or justify. Offline, no network.

land.why: Simulates real readers moment by moment: skim gate, quit points, next-day recall. Reports where the reading broke; never rewrites.

nudge.license_note: Custom terms. Fetched at install time, never redistributed by this repo.
nudge.why: Hands you 2-3 questions tied to what was just produced, so you audit the output instead of swallowing it.
